title: forgot password link
name: Forgot password link
rule: Forgot password link on every login.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Registration and Login Forms on Mobile

pass_when: Every login surface has a forgot-password link.
overview: Every login surface must include a forgot-password recovery link.
apply_when: Building or reviewing any login or sign-in surface.
not_when: Non-login flows that do not authenticate with a password.
agent_hint: Put a forgot-password link on every login surface.
description: Forgot password recovery must be available on every login. A forgot-password link belongs on every login surface so recovery is always reachable from sign-in without hunting elsewhere. Pass when every login surface has that path. Fail when a login offers no forgot-password link, leaving people stuck after an invalid or forgotten credential with no recovery path.
